text: Did a birthday party Saturday for a group of seven-year-olds. I tried the new bit where I pretend the balloon won't cooperate — just refuses to twist — and it killed. One kid laughed so hard he fell off his chair. The timing is getting better. I've been working on not rushing the pause before the reveal, letting the audience sit in the confusion for a beat longer. That's the whole trick, really. You have to trust that the silence is doing something even when it feels like nothing is happening. I want to do more adult shows but the party circuit pays and I like the kids.
